text: The Corda Ecosystem is the world's largest collection of real world asset networks. Over the last 10 years, the R3 ecosystem has built dozens and dozens of networks with billions of dollars of assets deployed across them. As chief Technology and product officer of R3, it was my responsibility to make the technical recommendation for which public network we aligned the Corda ecosystem with. The first requirement I had was the network had to have unbelievable scale. As you think about the number of transactions that are processed by the traditional finance the TRADFI system, the numbers are vast. I needed to know that the public network we aligned on could process those volumes with the right latency, could handle the volume, could handle the bandwidth, and had ridiculously low fees. With the Solana Ecosystem, I found a network and collection of engineers who were ruthlessly focused on delivering this. My second requirement was vision. We're here for the long term, our customers are here for the long term. We needed to know that the long term vision of the network we chose was aligned to our values and our ambition. We needed to know that this network would continue to scale, would continue to grow, would continue to have low fees. So we looked really closely at the leadership of all the key projects. What was driving them, what was their focus? And what I discovered was in Solana, this isn't just an idea. This isn't just something they focus on in their spare time. It's so crucial and central to the vision that it even has its own increased bandwidth, reduce latency, ibrl. That is almost the sole focus of the engineers driving this project. My third requirement was ecosystem. I needed to know that there would be a collection of developers, projects we could use, existing smart contracts, programs that our customers could build on. I needed to know that there was a flourishing collection of different projects, different companies, an entire ecosystem of builders and developers. With Solana, I found exactly the same thing. A huge and growing collection of providers and builders. If you don't believe me, go online, look at the videos from any Solana conference and just notice the affiliations of each of the presenters. All these high quality engineers are presenting are all from different firms, different projects. There's a genuine ecosystem aligning around this network. So there you have it. Scale, vision, ecosystem. That's why all three chose Solana.
